title: image
description: A local image with required alt text, an optional caption and a fit mode: the cover figure, or a picture anywhere on a slide. The image finishes loading before the step settles, and a missing or undecodable file is an element error naming the path.

src.description: Path to the image file, relative to the deck root (like a data path). Remote URLs, paths that leave the deck and paths containing `%` are not allowed. Changing it fades the new image in once it has loaded.

alt.description: Alt text: what the image shows, for people who cannot see it. Required and not blank.
examples: A diagram of exposure leading to outcome

fit.description: `contain` shows the whole image inside the box; `cover` fills the box and crops the overflow.

caption.description: An optional caption under the image, inline Markdown, in the note size and the muted colour.
examples: Synthetic figure made for this deck
